title_zh: 三条商业情报：谁在付钱、定价权在谁手里、流量换成了什么
title_en: Three Threads of Business Intel: Who Pays, Who Holds Pricing Power, What Traffic Became
desc_zh: 本周最具体的付费信号来自噪音取证，出现捐赠与复刻意愿；定价权的雷点是什么会被收回；部分搜索流量明显下滑，AI 引用是新增渠道——本周商业情报。
desc_en: The clearest payment signal came from noise evidence, with donation and replication intent; pricing power breaks over revocation; some search traffic is falling and AI citation is a new channel — this week's business intelligence.
